verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents end-to-end encrypted cloud sync/backups so codes restore on a new device after login, plus a recovery key to bypass 2FA lockouts, local encrypted backups, and a CLI export tool as additional restore paths. missing for 10: no independent hands-on account of a real device-loss recovery walkthrough, and no detail on exact steps to restore cloud-synced codes on a fresh device beyond general sync claims.
